segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Hey Jordan, do you have two minutes on the Northgate renewal?

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Yeah, so I’m between calls. What’s up?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: They’re good with the 24-month extension, 72 seats, same support level. They want the new term to start November 1 and they asked for annual invoicing instead of quarterly.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, comes to $38,400 a year before tax. I have the pricing sheet, the billing quote, and the contract request all showing 72 seats and November 1 now, but can you sanity check the numbers before I send the proposal? I was in and out of them yesterday and this morning.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Sure. Send me the draft PDF.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Just sent. The only customer-facing change from last year is the invoice cadence. No redlines to terms, no services add-on.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Looking now. Pricing matches: 72 seats at $44.44 per seat per month, 12% discount, annual total $38,400. Term says November 1, 2026 through October 31, 2028.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Great. I’ll send it to Erin and cc procurement. She said if they have it by 3 today, they can get a PO issued this week.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Looks clean. I’d just mention the first invoice will cover the full first year so they’re not surprised.
